newsitem.title: UK: GrandMet/Guinness brand profile, regional sales. [CORRECTED 11:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: GrandMet/Guinness brand profile, regional sales. [CORRECTED 11:10 GMT]

text.p: The merger of Grand Metropolitan Plc and Guinness will bring together the
following key brands and geographic areas;
Grand Metropolitan Plc
Group 1996 sales 8.727 billion stg, pre-tax profits 965 million
stg.
International Distillers and Vintners (IDV), GrandMet's spirits division, key brands include -- Smirnoff vodka, J&B, Baileys,
Malibu.
Pillsbury, GrandMet's North American food division -- key brands are Green Giant, Haagen-Dazs, Old El Paso and Progresso.
IDV sales by region -- 47 percent in Europe, 36 percent North
America, 17 percent rest of world.
GrandMet 1996 trading profit by division -- Pillsbury 39
percent, Burger King 15 percent, IDV 43 percent.
Guinness
1996 group turnover up 3 percent at 4.7 billion stg, pre-tax
profit 975 million stg.
United Distillers (UD), Guinness' spirits arm, key brands
include Johnnie Walker, Bell's, Gordon's Gin (corrects from "Gorton's"),
Tanqueray gin.
UD sales by region -- UK 16 percent, Rest of Europe 29 percent,
North America 20 percent, Asia Pacific 19 percent, Rest of World
16 percent.
Guinness Brewing Worldwide sales by region -- Britain 22.9
percent, Rest of Europe including Ireland 45.3 percent, North
America 7.3 percent, Asia Pacific 15.4 percent and Rest of World
8.9 percent.
The spirits market worldwide amounts to some 2.2 billion cases
of which some 600 million cases are branded spirits. Guinness
owned Johnnie Walker sold 11.6 million cases in 1996.

Bacardi is the world's top selling spirit at 19.3 million nine litre cases, IDV's Smirnoff sold 15 million cases, Johnnie Walker Red Label came in fourth at 7.3 million, and UD's Gordon's Gin (corrects) in sixth place with 5.3 million, according to researcher Impact International.
